subject: Discovery follow-up: ops walkthrough — please confirm one tight slot
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@datasavvy.com>, Natalie Ruiz <natalie@datasavvy.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 15 May 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery follow-up: ops walkthrough — please confirm one tight slot

Hi Liam / Natalie —

Looks like we missed each other on the discovery call this morning. No problem — I know these days get busy. We want to keep momentum on the ops/observability questions you raised and cover the specific integration points you mentioned (S3 retention rules + audit logging export).

Can you confirm one of these tight windows for a concise ops walkthrough with our Solutions Engineer and I? We only need 15–30 minutes depending on how deep you want to go:

- Monday May 17 — 10:00–10:15 PT (15m)
- Monday May 17 — 15:00–15:30 PT (30m)

If neither works, propose one alternative within this week and we’ll do our best to accommodate. If we don’t hear back in ~18 hours I’ll release the slots so they can be used for other customers — wanted to give you priority first.

I’m cc’ing Marissa (Customer Success) and Ben (Solutions) so we have the right people on the call if you confirm. Attaching a short outline for the walkthrough and our SOC2 summary in case you want to scan ahead.

Attachments: redwood-map-outline.pdf (2pg), SOC2-summary.pdf (1pg)

Thanks —
Vivek Kulkarni
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
vivek@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0197

Hey Vivek —

Really sorry — an urgent exec sync ran over and I couldn’t make this morning. Appreciate the follow-up and the attachments.

Monday the 17th is tight for us; would Tuesday May 18 at 11:00 PT work instead? We’d prefer 30 minutes if possible — we want to bring our infra lead and ask a couple of deeper questions about encryption-in-motion.

Quick note: can you confirm whether you can walk through the audit export format end-to-end? If so, that will help our SREs decide whether to proceed to a short POC.

Thanks —
Liam
Head of Engineering, DataSavvy Inc.
liam.oneill@datasavvy.com | +1 206-555-0123

Marissa / Ben —

Looping you in because Liam from DataSavvy just asked for Tue May 18 11:00 PT for a 30m walkthrough. He specifically wants to validate audit export format and encryption-in-motion behaviour — looks like one of their SREs will join.

Plan: Ben, could you be ready to show the export JSON schema and a quick demo of the export flow (2–3 min)? Marissa, can you prep the standard POC checklist and any items we should surface for security (KMS, retention)? I’ll send the calendar invite once you confirm availability.

If either of you are unavailable at 11:00 PT, please propose either 11:30 PT or 15:00 PT on Tue and I’ll negotiate with them — but we want to keep this tight (they asked for 30m).

Thanks —
Vivek
Account Executive

Hi Liam / Natalie —

Thanks for the quick reply — Tue May 18 at 11:00 PT works for us. I’ve scheduled a 30-minute ops walkthrough and attached an .ics invite. Agenda (tight):

- 0–5m: Quick intros and goals for the session (Liam / SRE priorities)
- 5–15m: Ben walks export flow + JSON schema and retention knobs
- 15–25m: Marissa covers POC checklist, KMS/HSM integration notes
- 25–30m: Next steps / decision on short POC

Attachments: invite.ics (calendar invite). I’ve also reattached the short outline and SOC2 summary so your SRE can scan before the call. If there are any additional items you need us to cover (e.g., sample encrypted payloads) please reply and we’ll add them.

If anything comes up and you need to move, please give us a 24-hour heads up; otherwise we’ll assume we’re on. Looking forward to it.

Best —
